Welcome to Devlore

Devlore watches your GitHub repos and uses Claude to keep their documentation current automatically — drafting a log entry on every push, consolidating official docs at each release, and answering questions about any linked project right here.

Select a linked project from the sidebar to explore its documentation and ask questions.

Link a project

Every linked project gets a docs/PRODUCT.md — your project's living discovery doc: vision, requirements, decisions, reference material. Keep it updated, and use it as source-of-truth context when brainstorming or planning with an AI agent.

One-time setup: a GitHub token Devlore uses to write workflow files and secrets into repos you link or create.

Create a fine-grained token — Repository access: All repositories; Permissions: Actions (Read and write — needed to run the initial codebase analysis), Contents (Read and write), Secrets (Read and write), Workflows (Read and write), Administration (Read and write — needed to create a new repo)

Devlore stores your documentation in a private vault repo. If you're linking a project a teammate already set up, Devlore normally detects and uses that project's existing vault automatically — this screen means none could be found for , so a new devlore-vault repo will be created there instead.

/

Creates a new private GitHub repo, wired up and ready to go.

Set up Devlore

Entered once, stored securely in your OS keychain — never written to a file.
